# Tasks Document

* [ ] 1\. Create src/api/auth.proto
  * File: src/api/auth.proto
  * Define `LoginRequest`, `SessionToken`, `LoginError`, `LoginResponse` (oneof), `LogoutRequest`, `LogoutResponse`, and the `AuthenticationService` (Login, Logout) exactly as specified in design.md's Data Models section
  * Use `syntax = "proto3";`, `package etalii.adp;`, `option csharp_namespace = "EtAlii.Adp";`
  * Purpose: Establish the contract for Requirement 1 (mandatory login gate)
  * *Leverage: .spec-workflow/specs/login-project-selection/design.md (Data Models: auth.proto), src/api/connection.proto (existing package etalii.adp convention)*
  * *Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 4.1*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Protocol Buffers/gRPC contract author | Task: Create src/api/auth.proto defining LoginRequest, SessionToken, LoginError, LoginResponse (oneof session/error), LogoutRequest, LogoutResponse, and the AuthenticationService with Login/Logout rpcs exactly as shown in design.md's Data Models section, following requirements 1.1-1.5 and 4.1 | Restrictions: proto3 syntax only, no ProjectService/AdpService content in this file, field numbers must match design.md exactly | Leverage: design.md's Data Models and Components sections | Success: file parses as valid proto3, matches design.md in message/field/service names and numbers. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 2\. Create src/api/projects.proto
  * File: src/api/projects.proto
  * Define `Project`, `ListProjectsRequest`/`Response`, `AddProjectRequest`, `AddProjectError`, `AddProjectResponse` (oneof), `RemoveProjectRequest`/`Response`, and the `ProjectService` (ListProjects, AddProject, RemoveProject) exactly as specified in design.md's Data Models section
  * Import `connection.proto` (for `Path`, used as `AddProjectRequest.path` and `Project.path`)
  * Purpose: Establish the contract for Requirements 2 and 5 (project grid, persisted user-managed project list)
  * *Leverage: .spec-workflow/specs/login-project-selection/design.md (Data Models: projects.proto), src/api/connection.proto (task dependency, for Path)*
  * *Requirements: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 5.5*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Protocol Buffers/gRPC contract author | Task: Create src/api/projects.proto defining Project (id, name, path), ListProjectsRequest/Response, AddProjectRequest, AddProjectError, AddProjectResponse (oneof added/error), RemoveProjectRequest/Response, and the ProjectService with ListProjects/AddProject/RemoveProject rpcs exactly as shown in design.md's Data Models section, importing connection.proto for Path, following requirements 2.1-2.4 and 5.1-5.5 | Restrictions: proto3 syntax only, do not inline a copy of Path, field numbers must match design.md exactly | Leverage: design.md's Data Models and Components sections, src/api/connection.proto | Success: file parses as valid proto3 with the import resolving against src/api/connection.proto, matches design.md in message/field/service names and numbers. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 3\. Validate auth.proto and projects.proto compile alongside the existing core contract
  * Files: src/api/auth.proto, src/api/projects.proto (verification only, no edits expected unless a compile error is found)
  * Run a throwaway local `protoc`/`Grpc.Tools` C# codegen pass over all six `.proto` files in src/api/ together (the four existing core files plus these two) and confirm it succeeds with no errors
  * Do not check the generated stub code into the repository — this task only proves the contract is valid
  * Purpose: Confirm the new contracts are internally consistent with the existing core contract before backend/client work depends on them
  * *Leverage: .spec-workflow/specs/grpc-core-communication-specification/design.md (Testing Strategy: Contract Validation) for the validation approach used previously*
  * *Requirements: 1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.4, 4.1, 5.1-5.5*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Build/tooling engineer verifying a gRPC contract | Task: Using a throwaway local setup (e.g. a scratch .csproj referencing Grpc.Tools and Google.Protobuf), compile all six src/api/\*.proto files together and confirm codegen succeeds with zero errors/warnings; if any error is found, fix the specific file(s) at fault to match design.md's intent and re-verify | Restrictions: the throwaway project used for validation must not be committed to the repository; only fixes to the two new proto files (if any are needed) should be committed | Success: all six files compile together with no errors. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 4\. Implement IAuthenticator abstraction and local-mode default in EtAlii.Adp.Backend
  * Files: src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Authentication/IAuthenticator.cs, src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Authentication/LocalAuthenticator.cs
  * Define `IAuthenticator` with a method to validate a username/credential pair and return success/failure
  * Implement `LocalAuthenticator` validating against a single configured local credential (Requirement 1.4)
  * Purpose: Provide the pluggable credential-validation seam design.md's `AuthenticationService` depends on
  * *Leverage: .spec-workflow/specs/login-project-selection/design.md (Components: AuthenticationService), .spec-workflow/steering/structure.md (EtAlii.Adp.Backend project)*
  * *Requirements: 1.4*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend .NET Developer | Task: Create the IAuthenticator interface and a LocalAuthenticator default implementation in EtAlii.Adp.Backend (create the project under src/backend/ per structure.md if it does not yet exist) that validates against a single locally configured credential, satisfying requirement 1.4's local-only auth mode with no external identity provider | Restrictions: do not implement any gRPC service in this task, do not hardcode the credential value in code (it must be configurable), follow structure.md's PascalCase naming and single-responsibility file conventions | Leverage: design.md's AuthenticationService component description | Success: IAuthenticator is a clean, testable interface; LocalAuthenticator implements it correctly and is unit-testable without any gRPC/network dependency. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 5\. Implement session store and session interceptor in EtAlii.Adp.Backend
  * Files: src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Sessions/ISessionStore.cs, src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Sessions/InMemorySessionStore.cs, src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Sessions/SessionInterceptor.cs
  * Implement a session store issuing/validating/revoking opaque session tokens, and a gRPC server interceptor that rejects calls without a valid token
  * Purpose: Provide the single enforcement point design.md describes for Requirement 1.6 and `grpc-core-communication` Requirement 5.1
  * *Leverage: .spec-workflow/specs/login-project-selection/design.md (Components: Session interceptor), .spec-workflow/specs/grpc-core-communication/requirements.md (Requirement 5)*
  * *Requirements: 1.5, 1.6*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend .NET Developer with gRPC interceptor experience | Task: Implement ISessionStore/InMemorySessionStore for issuing, validating, and revoking session tokens, and a SessionInterceptor (Grpc.Core.Interceptors.Interceptor or ASP.NET Core gRPC interceptor) that rejects any call lacking a valid session token with UNAUTHENTICATED, satisfying requirements 1.5 and 1.6 | Restrictions: the interceptor must not be specific to any one service (it is applied to AuthenticationService, ProjectService, and AdpService per design.md's Architecture diagram), do not persist sessions to disk (in-memory is sufficient per design.md) | Leverage: design.md's Session interceptor component and Architecture diagram | Success: interceptor correctly passes valid-token calls and rejects missing/invalid/expired tokens with UNAUTHENTICATED; session store is unit-testable in isolation. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 6\. Implement AuthenticationService gRPC service in EtAlii.Adp.Backend
  * Files: src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Authentication/AuthenticationService.cs
  * Implement the generated `AuthenticationService` base class using `IAuthenticator` (task 4) and `ISessionStore` (task 5)
  * Purpose: Wire the Login/Logout contract from auth.proto to real credential validation and session issuance, completing Requirement 1
  * *Leverage: src/api/auth.proto (task 1), src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Authentication/IAuthenticator.cs (task 4), src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Sessions/ISessionStore.cs (task 5)*
  * *Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 4.1, 4.2*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend .NET Developer with gRPC service experience | Task: Implement AuthenticationServiceImpl extending the generated AuthenticationService base, using IAuthenticator to validate credentials and ISessionStore to issue a SessionToken on success or return a LoginError on failure, and Logout to revoke a session, satisfying requirements 1.1-1.3 and 4.1-4.2 | Restrictions: Login itself must NOT go through the session interceptor (no token exists yet), do not duplicate credential-validation logic here (delegate to IAuthenticator) | Leverage: task 1's auth.proto-generated types, task 4's IAuthenticator, task 5's ISessionStore | Success: valid credentials return a session token, invalid credentials return LoginError without a token, Logout revokes the session so subsequent calls with that token are rejected by the interceptor. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 7\. Implement file-backed per-user project store in EtAlii.Adp.Backend
  * Files: src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Projects/IProjectStore.cs, src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Projects/FileProjectStore.cs
  * Implement list/add/remove against a per-user `projects.json` file at `{app-data}/EtAlii.Adp/users/{user-id}/projects.json`, exactly as specified in design.md's Data Models section
  * Purpose: Provide the persisted, file-based (no database) project list backing Requirement 5
  * *Leverage: .spec-workflow/specs/login-project-selection/design.md (Data Models: Per-user project store), .spec-workflow/steering/tech.md (File-based storage over a database)*
  * *Requirements: 5.1, 5.3, 5.4*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend .NET Developer | Task: Implement IProjectStore/FileProjectStore reading and writing the per-user projects.json file at the path specified in design.md's Data Models section, supporting list/add/remove operations that persist immediately, satisfying requirements 5.1, 5.3, and 5.4 | Restrictions: must validate an added path resolves to an accessible folder before persisting it (do not persist invalid entries), must not delete/modify the target project folder itself on removal (only the list entry), follow tech.md's file-based/no-database philosophy | Leverage: design.md's Data Models section for the exact file location and shape | Success: list/add/remove round-trip correctly through the JSON file, survive a simulated process restart (re-reading the file), and an invalid folder path is rejected without corrupting the existing file. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 8\. Implement ProjectService gRPC service in EtAlii.Adp.Backend
  * Files: src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Projects/ProjectService.cs
  * Implement the generated `ProjectService` base class using `IProjectStore` (task 7)
  * Purpose: Wire the ListProjects/AddProject/RemoveProject contract from projects.proto to the file-backed store, completing Requirements 2 and 5
  * *Leverage: src/api/projects.proto (task 2), src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend/Projects/IProjectStore.cs (task 7)*
  * *Requirements: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 5.5*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend .NET Developer with gRPC service experience | Task: Implement ProjectServiceImpl extending the generated ProjectService base, delegating list/add/remove to IProjectStore, returning AddProjectResponse.error (AddProjectError) for an invalid path rather than throwing, satisfying requirements 2.1-2.4 and 5.2-5.5 | Restrictions: all three rpcs run behind the session interceptor (task 5) so this implementation can assume an authenticated caller, do not implement path validation logic here (delegate to IProjectStore from task 7) | Leverage: task 2's projects.proto-generated types, task 7's IProjectStore | Success: ListProjects reflects the current persisted list, AddProject with a valid path adds and returns it, AddProject with an invalid path returns AddProjectError without changing the list, RemoveProject removes only the list entry. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 9\. Wire local-mode credential configuration in EtAlii.Adp.Backend.Service
  * Files: src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend.Service/appsettings.json, src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend.Service/appsettings.developer.json, src/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Backend.Service/Program.cs (or Startup wiring, modify existing)
  * Register `LocalAuthenticator` (task 4), `InMemorySessionStore`/`SessionInterceptor` (task 5), and `FileProjectStore` (task 7) for dependency injection, and add the local-mode credential setting to the developer appsettings
  * Purpose: Make the F5, standalone scenario runnable end-to-end without an external identity provider, per Requirement 1.4
  * *Leverage: .spec-workflow/steering/structure.md (EtAlii.Adp.Backend.Service hosting appsettings.json/appsettings.developer.json), tasks 4/5/7*
  * *Requirements: 1.4*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend .NET Developer with ASP.NET Core hosting experience | Task: Register the authentication, session, and project-store services from tasks 4, 5, and 7 in EtAlii.Adp.Backend.Service's DI container and gRPC pipeline (including the SessionInterceptor), and add the local-mode default credential to appsettings.developer.json (not appsettings.json, to avoid a real default credential in production config), satisfying requirement 1.4 | Restrictions: do not commit a real/production credential anywhere, keep the wiring in the existing Program.cs/hosting setup rather than creating a parallel bootstrap path | Leverage: structure.md's description of EtAlii.Adp.Backend.Service | Success: the backend runs standalone (F5) with a login using the local-mode credential from appsettings.developer.json succeeding end-to-end. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
* [ ] 10\. Implement client auth context in client/
  * Files: client/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx, client/src/auth/grpcAuthInterceptor.ts
  * Implement a React context holding the session token (in memory) and a grpc-web interceptor/call option that attaches it to every outgoing call; on an UNAUTHENTICATED response, clear the context and signal a redirect to login
  * Purpose: Provide the client-side session plumbing every other client task depends on, per Requirement 1.5 and 4.2
  * *Leverage: .spec-workflow/specs/login-project-selection/design.md (Components: LoginPage/ProjectGridPage, session token handling), .spec-workflow/steering/tech.md (React + TypeScript, grpc-web transport)*
  * *Requirements: 1.5, 4.2*
  * *Prompt: Implement the task for spec login-project-selection, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Frontend React/TypeScript Developer | Task: Create the client/ React+TypeScript+Vite app scaffold if it does not yet exist (per structure.md's client/ folder convention), then implement AuthContext (session token state, login/logout actions) and a grpc-web call-credentials/interceptor helper that attaches the current session token to outgoing calls and reacts to an UNAUTHENTICATED response by clearing the context, satisfying requirements 1.5 and 4.2 | Restrictions: do not persist the session token to localStorage/cookies (in-memory only, per design.md's client state discard on session end), do not implement LoginPage/ProjectGridPage UI in this task | Leverage: design.md's client component descriptions | Success: AuthContext correctly holds/clears a token, the interceptor attaches it to calls, and an UNAUTHENTICATED response clears the context so a consuming component can redirect to login. Mark this task in-progress (\[-]) in tasks.md before starting, and mark it complete (\[x]) and log the implementation with log-implementation after finishing.*
